_readme: Sensor settings for the IR (ToF) ranges of acquisition/ir_scan.py in demo/live.py: no range or bearing correction (the IR ranges are already corrected by acquisition/ir_live.IR_FIT; the ArUco fits of config/sensor_calib.json must not be applied to them). sigma_pos and p_d are first guesses for the IR aimed with OptiTrack (about 1-2 cm after correction, every box ranged), to be measured.
